title: Buddy Tate, 'the Texas Pimp'
summary: Buddy Tate warns his daughter off Gus in a running joke.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: And is that what you do with Buddy Tate?
Oh, Buddy Tate, yeah, the brightest -- I call him the Texas Pimp.
His daughter was in New York, out on Long Island. She's out there to listen to the band.
I came up and I saw Buddy, and he's sitting there, and his daughter -- a pretty girl, too, yes, she is.
A pretty girl, I know her, too, yeah.

And I say, 'My goodness.' He said, 'Never mind that. Honey, see that guy? Don't say nothing to him. He's a dirty guy, don't trust him, don't turn your back on him.' I said, 'Who is that? You don't want to introduce me to the young lady? This is my daughter and I don't want to catch you hanging around her.'
That's why I don't like him, see.
I can't flirt with nobody. He just messes me up.
